default.question: What is your return policy?
default.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all products. Simply contact our support team to initiate a return.

default.question: How long does shipping take?
default.answer: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping options are available at checkout.

default.question: Do you offer international shipping?
default.answer: Yes, we ship to over 100 countries worldwide. Shipping costs and delivery times vary by location.
